name: e-Smart Trailing
summary: e-Smart Trailing is a utility Expert Advisor that manages existing open positions by applying an intelligent trailing stop mechanism. It does not open trades on its own but dynamically adjusts stop-loss levels based on profit thresholds and trailing step parameters to protect gains. The EA supports configuration of profit activation levels, trailing step sizes, and trailing stop distances.
summary_zh: e-Smart Trailing是一个工具型EA，通过智能追踪止损机制管理现有持仓。它不自行开仓，而是根据利润阈值和追踪步长参数动态调整止损水平以保护浮盈。该EA支持配置利润激活水平、追踪步长和追踪止损距离等参数。
strategy_analysis: e-Smart Trailing是一个纯工具型EA，不包含任何入场策略逻辑，仅负责对已有持仓进行追踪止损管理。其核心机制是：当持仓浮盈达到用户设定的利润阈值（ProfitTrailing）时，EA开始激活追踪止损功能。激活后，止损会根据追踪步长（StepTrailing）逐步向有利方向移动，每次移动的距离由StepTrailing参数控制，而止损与当前价格的间距由TrailingStop参数决定。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓或加仓逻辑，仅管理已有仓位的止损位。资金管理方面，EA依赖用户自行设置合理的参数来控制风险敞口，本身不包含资金管理模块。整体策略逻辑简洁明了，专注于止损优化，但缺乏对市场波动率（如ATR）的自适应能力。
strategy_analysis_en: e-Smart Trailing is a purely utility EA that contains no entry strategy logic, focusing solely on trailing stop management for existing positions. Its core mechanism activates trailing stop functionality when a position's floating profit reaches a user-defined profit threshold (ProfitTrailing). Once activated, the stop-loss moves incrementally in the favorable direction based on the StepTrailing parameter, while the distance between the stop-loss and current price is governed by the TrailingStop parameter. Regarding position sizing, the EA does not handle position opening or scaling, only managing stop-loss levels of existing positions. For money management, the EA relies entirely on the user to set reasonable parameters to control risk exposure, lacking any built-in money management module. The overall strategy logic is clean and focused on stop-loss optimization, but it lacks adaptivity to market volatility (such as ATR-based dynamic adjustments).

parameters.name: ProfitTrailing
parameters.description: 激活追踪止损的利润阈值（点数）
parameters.description_en: Profit threshold to activate trailing stop (points)

parameters.name: StepTrailing
parameters.description: 追踪止损步长（点数），每次移动止损的最小距离

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损距离（点数），止损与当前价格的最小间距

pros: 逻辑简洁清晰，专注于追踪止损管理，功能单一不易出错
参数设计直观，用户可灵活配置利润激活阈值、步长和止损距离
作为辅助工具可与任何开仓策略EA配合使用，兼容性好
pros_en: Clean and simple logic focused on trailing stop management, single-function design reduces error potential
Intuitive parameter design allows flexible configuration of profit threshold, step size, and stop distance
Works as a companion tool with any entry-strategy EA, offering good compatibility
cons: 追踪止损参数为固定点数，缺乏基于ATR等波动率指标的自适应机制
默认参数均为0，新用户若不修改参数直接运行则EA不会执行任何操作
未区分多空方向的差异化追踪策略，对多头和空头使用相同参数
cons_en: Trailing parameters are fixed pip values with no ATR-based or volatility-adaptive mechanism
Default parameters are all zero, meaning the EA does nothing if a user runs it without modification
No differentiated trailing strategy for long vs short positions, using identical parameters for both directions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态追踪止损模式，使止损距离能自适应市场波动率变化
为多空方向分别设置追踪参数，以适应不同趋势特征下的止损需求
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop mode so stop distances adapt to changing market volatility
Provide separate trailing parameters for long and short positions to accommodate different trending characteristics

risk_points: 默认参数为0时EA不执行任何操作，可能导致用户误以为EA已生效而实际未提供保护
固定点数追踪止损在极端波动行情中可能过于紧密或过于宽松
risk_points_en: Default parameters of zero mean the EA does nothing, which may mislead users into thinking protection is active when it is not
Fixed-pip trailing stops can be too tight or too loose during extreme volatility conditions

It does not open trades on its own but dynamically adjusts stop-loss levels based on profit thresholds and trailing step parameters to protect gains. The EA supports configuration of profit activation levels, trailing step sizes, and trailing stop distances.
